records.text: I believe Charlie Kirk was most likely murdered for his evolving views on Israel, not for his opinions on transgenderism, though I may be wrong.
records.speaker: Tucker Carlson

appearances.snippet: Charlie Kirk was murdered, and he was not murdered for his opinions on transgenderism. Obviously, I believe—and most people who knew him well, as I did, and were friends with him, as I was, believe—he was most likely murdered for his evolving views on Israel. ... I may be wrong now, but I am sincere. I'm saying what I believe is true

verification.notes: The primary recording confirms Carlson expressly framed this as his belief, contrasted Israel with transgenderism as a motive, and immediately caveated that he may be wrong. This result verifies the accurately conveyed opinion, not the still-unproven murder-motive theory.

records.text: Those of us who knew Charlie Kirk best—a group that does not include Tucker Carlson—believe Tyler Robinson killed him and was motivated by transgender radicalism; Tucker Carlson is lying.

appearances.snippet: "Actually, those of us who knew Charlie (Charlie Kirk) best—a group that doesn't include Tucker (Tucker Carlson)—do think that Tyler Robinson did it and was motivated by transgender radicalism. Tucker (Tucker Carlson) is lying."

verification.notes: A live mirror of the Blake Neff post reproduces the quoted language that those who knew Kirk best believed Tyler Robinson did it, that transgender radicalism motivated him, and that Tucker was lying.
